cause_quote: The new registered host-link reconciler used `if (record.source !== "npm" || !record.installPath?.trim()) { continue; }`, so it skipped ClawHub records in both audit and repair mode.
user_saw: After copying or upgrading a source-backed installation, a ClawHub plugin could still fail validation after `openclaw doctor --fix` because its host link pointed to the old checkout.
summary: The fix extends Doctor and post-update host-link repair to registered ClawHub plugins under the existing ownership checks.
reasoning: The parent already recorded ClawHub installs as `source: "clawhub"` and linked them to the host during installation, while Doctor's existing repair scanned only managed npm roots. PR #118304 introduced Doctor's repair for registered installs under the extensions root, and its npm-only filter excluded ClawHub records from the start.
